scholarships.title: COMSTECH Fellowships for Research and Trainings in Human Nutrition, Nutraceuticals and Food Sciences
scholarships.official_source: OIC-COMSTECH (Ministerial Standing Committee on Scientific and Technological Cooperation of the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation)

eligibility: Be a citizen of an OIC member state (the page explicitly names Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Benin, Burkina Faso, Chad, Comoros, Djibouti, Gambia, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Mali, Mauritania, Mozambique, Niger, Senegal, Sierra Leone, Somalia, Sudan, Togo, Uganda and Yemen among the OIC least-developed countries)
Hold at least a Bachelor's degree; a Master's or PhD is an asset
Hold an academic background in food security, agriculture, food science, food safety or another related field
Bachelor's degree holders: at least 5 years of substantive professional experience, preferably in a government or national research institution, after university graduation
Master's or PhD holders: at least 3 years of professional experience, preferably in a government or national research institution
Be fluent and proficient in English, with excellent written and oral communication skills
Be available full-time, 40 hours per week, for the entire duration of the fellowship
Be aged 35 or under for Master's/PhD holders, or 45 or under for post-doctoral researchers
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to citizens of all OIC member states. Applicants need at least a Bachelor's degree, with a Master's or PhD an asset, and an academic background in food security, agriculture, food science, food safety or a related field. Experience requirements differ by degree level, and applicants must be fluent in English and available full-time for the whole fellowship.
benefits: Supervision and mentoring of local training
coverage: Supervision and mentoring of local training
requirements: Match one of the eight published thematic areas
Meet the degree and experience thresholds for your qualification level
Commit to 40 hours per week, full-time, for the whole placement
Be within the age limit for your level
Submit through the official COMSTECH application form
documents: Evidence of professional experience (5 years post-graduation for Bachelor's holders; 3 years for Master's/PhD holders)
CV documenting research alignment with a published thematic area
existing.english_requirement: Fluent and proficient in English, with excellent written and oral communication skills. The fellowship is conducted in the English language.
application_method: Review the eight thematic areas and the list of Consortium of Excellence host institutions
Prepare an application aligned to one thematic area and to your degree/experience level
Applications are considered on a first-come, first-served basis until the 10 available places are filled
existing.selection_notes: Awards are made by OIC-COMSTECH together with the Joint Scholarship Committee of the host institutions, based on scientific merit. Only 10 fellowships are available and they are awarded first-come, first-served subject to eligibility. The page also states that COMSTECH accepts applications on a yearly basis and selects candidates against pre-approved selection criteria.
existing.best_fit: Early-career researchers and professionals from OIC member states who hold a Master's or PhD (or a Bachelor's plus five years' experience) in food security, agriculture, food science, food safety, plant biotechnology, nutrition or agri-business, are under 35 (or 45 for post-docs), and can commit three to six full-time months.
existing.notes: This is a first-come, first-served fellowship with only 10 places, so delay is effectively equivalent to missing the award. The official page does not state a fixed closing date, so deadline_precision is recorded as rolling and deadline_date is null. The page itemises airfare, visa fees, accommodation, subsistence, supervision and mentoring, but it does not explicitly state that tuition or enrolment fees are paid, so tuition_coverage is recorded as false and fully_funded as false rather than inferred. Eligibility spans OIC member states across Africa, the Middle East and Asia; the region is set to Africa because the explicitly enumerated OIC least-developed-country list on the page is predominantly African.
existing.duration: 3 to 6 months, extendable upon recommendation from the host institution
existing.application_period: Yearly, on a first-come, first-served basis while places remain; 10 fellowships available. The official page shows Call Status: 'The call is currently open'.
existing.deadline_display: No closing date published; COMSTECH states 'COMSTECH will accept applications on a yearly basis' and that only 10 fellowships are awarded on a first-come, first-served basis
